prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static List<String> liveCache(List<String[]> entries, long now)
Behavior: Each entry is key,value,writtenAt,ttl; keys match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. now, writtenAt and ttl must be integers in 0..10,000,000, and writtenAt+ttl must not exceed 10,000,000 when ttl is nonzero. Reject duplicate keys. ttl zero never expires; otherwise live exactly while now < writtenAt+ttl. Return key=value pairs in Unicode code-point key order.
Visible example: at now 15, a value written at 10 with ttl 5 is expired, while ttl 0 remains live.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<String> liveCache(List<String[]>e,long n){if(n<0||n>10000000)return null;var s=new HashSet<String>();var o=new ArrayList<String>();for(var x:e){if(x.length!=4||!x[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!s.add(x[0]))return null;long w,t;try{w=Long.parseLong(x[2]);t=Long.parseLong(x[3]);}catch(Exception z){return null;}if(!Long.toString(w).equals(x[2])||!Long.toString(t).equals(x[3])||w<0||w>10000000||t<0||t>10000000||(t>0&&w+t>10000000))return null;if(t==0||n<w+t)o.add(x[0]+"="+x[1]);}Collections.sort(o);return o;}}
